mxCell.value: We can implement other versions of EventRepository in the future. For now, all data is stored as serialized objects.
EventService uses EventRepository to load/save data models in an abstract manner, and contains filter and sort logic. Also, for now, it provides validation logic.

Top-level UI. Maintains an EventQuery, and shows filtered / sorted Events. If user wants to add or edit an event, it opens EventUI, then inserts / updates the returned Event.
Allows user to add / edit / view Event details. If user wants to manage reservations, will run ReservationListUI then coalesce returned Event.reservations.
Allows view/add/edit/delete reservations of an Event. If user wants to add/edit a Reservation, it opens ReservationUI, then coalesces returned Reservation.
Allows user to add / edit / view a Reservation.
provides common functions for defining and parsing user's command line input

Event Management System
Class Diagram

For the first version, we simply have Event objects. Reservations are fully contained within an event, therefore they have no "id" field.

There is no "Attendee" model.
In the future, we can add an "isCancelled" and "dateCancelled". This will require additional validation logic and UI components.
